column1: # Campaign 25 source evidence for the immutable bounded configured catalog.

column5: The immutable configured catalog exposes checked case-insensitive table lookup by qualified name and stable ID plus explicit unknown and ambiguous outcomes; dynamic InfoSchema interfaces, schema versions, allocators, policies, bundles, partitions, views, sequences, temporary tables, and DDL visibility remain open.

ConfiguredCatalog preserves source table order, fully qualified case-insensitive lookup, unqualified ambiguity, and stable physical IDs using the shared ConfiguredTable validator; runtime schema lease, cache refill, temporary and MDL overlays, InfoSchema v2, virtual schemas, and mutation remain open.

The bounded catalog admits only validated nonpartitioned signed-BIGINT base-table descriptors and deliberately does not claim TiDB table construction, virtual system tables, partition metadata, generated columns, constraints, or statistics behavior.
